host_delta: Tighten the already-merged six-class FIELD egress reducer in place: legacy packets keep the recovery adapter, while new field-work-packet/v0.1 packets enter a strict authority/evidence/RETURN lane.
before: The merged reducer correctly prevented historical self-promotion and mapped broad legacy packet shapes to NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE, but it did not require canonical OBJECT + AUTHORITY, bound NEXT cardinality, require evidence for canonical DELTA, or reduce STOP/RETURN dispositions explicitly.
changes: /lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs — canonical packet detection, validation and strict reduction; broad legacy adapter preserved
/control/FIELD_PACKET_EGRESS.json — recoverable canonical fields + precedence + RETURN disposition contract
/tools/field-egress-reducer-selftest.mjs — legacy A-H retained plus strict authority/evidence/STOP/RETURN/NEXT cases
/AGENTS.md — new workers prefer field-work-packet/v0.1 instead of inventing packet shapes
proved_by_test: explicit egress:NOW cannot manufacture canonical NOW
WAITING blocks NEXT and maps to GATE
canonical DELTA without EVIDENCE maps to RESIDUE
canonical DELTA with EVIDENCE maps to DELTA
NEXT > 3 maps to RESIDUE; NEXT 1..3 maps to NEXT
RETURN TRIGGER maps to NEXT only when a bounded NEXT exists
legacy packet A-H behavior remains intact
preserves: no new route, dashboard, queue, planner, store, or canonical packet cache
residue: Do not migrate historical packet bodies merely to satisfy the new schema; the legacy adapter exists for recovery.
Do not surface another packet UI. The contract belongs behind FIELD machine/handoff projections unless a real consumer proves missing legibility.
stop: After exact-head CI, merge and return to ordinary FIELD work; do not elaborate the packet model without a failed real consumer.
